candidates.description: Triggers when a user asks to score or prioritize already-segmented leads against persona prose in a connected GTM context. Not for assigning labels, lead research, account scoring, rubric authoring, numeric scoring, or repository management.
candidates.rationale: Direct labels-in task and sibling exclusions.

candidates.description: Triggers when a user asks to score, rank, qualify, or prioritize people using supplied persona labels and qualitative fit bands in a connected GTM context. Not for assigning labels, researching people, account workflows, authoring rubrics or point systems, numeric scoring, or managing the context repository.
candidates.rationale: Covers common scoring verbs and makes the supplied-label seam explicit.

candidates.description: Triggers when a user wants strong-fit, good-fit, weak-fit, or no-fit assigned to people who already have persona labels. Not for segmentation, enrichment, lead research, account workflows, scoring-model design, arithmetic, or context setup.
candidates.rationale: Names the observable output vocabulary and excludes scoring-model design.
